what: ADUO (Additional Development and Upgrade Opportunities): the FIA measures each manufacturer's internal combustion engine (ICE) output over set periods. The best one is the benchmark; 2-4% behind earns 1 extra engine upgrade (homologation) in 2026 and 1 in 2027, more than 4% behind earns 2 and 2. Exact figures are confidential, only bands are published. It measures the ICE only, not the battery or energy deployment.

periods.name: Review 3
periods.note: The FIA said the gaps changed but not enough to grant new upgrades. Bands were not published.
